name: Paired primitive matrix for Ca_HVA m+h
authorization: Exact Task 3e artifact must report task4_authorized=true.
domain: Isolated Ca_HVA m+h under held voltage
forbidden_inputs: any future Task 4 sealed tuples before checkpoint freeze

paired_contract.tie_break: earliest checkpoint then lower parameter count

numerical_contract.formula_role: accuracy oracle, not a learned candidate

interpretation_rules.lut_or_chebyshev_best: prefer numerical primitive unless learned family has a material implementation advantage
interpretation_rules.direct_mlp_or_gru_best: physical structure is not required for held-voltage endpoint accuracy
interpretation_rules.physical_tau_within_10_percent: retain physical-tau as the mechanistic default
interpretation_rules.direct_z_best_only_at_fixed_dt: defer decision until Task 6 dt stress
interpretation_rules.all_learned_fail: do not scale; revisit objective/support before Task 6

scope: Task 4 ranks primitives in held voltage. It does not establish sufficiency for time-varying voltage paths.
latency_policy: Learned three-seed ensembles are benchmarked on GPU and numerical primitives on CPU; cross-device latency is reported but never used as a direct winner criterion.
task5_integration: Checkpoint curves provide the first mini scaling law without duplicate training.
task6_authorization: A valid finite matrix with frozen sealed evaluation authorizes Task 6 stress testing; it does not select using sealed outcomes.
